name: AdScope ad-analytics OG social card by AdScope
description: A 1200×630 social card that uses a cropped product screenshot as the entire composition — no headline, the UI is the message. A top band of four candy-coloured KPI cards with oversized black numerals acts as the headline, above a toolbar (source chips, search, segmented toggle) and a dense three-column grid of campaign cards that deliberately bleeds off the bottom edge. A phone mockup overlapping the lower-left adds depth and previews the mobile app, while the black canvas peeking at the rounded top-left corner frames the whole thing as a floating screenshot on dark ground.
